results.name: Air Twisting Crunch
instructions: Lie down on your back with your knees bent and heels on the floor.
Place your hands behind your head.
Raise your chest and twist your torso to one side while bringing the opposite knee close.
Return to the initial position and repeat by twisting towards the other side.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maximize muscle activation and protect your lower back.
Perform the movement slowly and with control, avoiding the use of momentum to maximize effectiveness.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you twist and bring your elbow to your knee, and inhaling as you switch sides.
results.description: Air Twisting Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Quadriceps.

results.name: Alternate Arm Leg Plank Hold
instructions: Start in a plank position with your elbows directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Lift your right arm and left leg simultaneously, extending them straight out while maintaining balance. Hold this position for a brief period of 1-2 seconds.
Lower your right arm and left leg back to the plank position.
Lift your left arm and right leg simultaneously, extending them straight out and holding for a brief period of 1-2 seconds before returning to the plank position.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and prevent your hips from sagging.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and maintain balance.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your arm and leg and inhaling as you hold the position.
results.description: Alternate Arm Leg Plank Hold is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Back, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Alternate Arm Leg Plank Rest Pause
instructions: Start in a plank position with your elbows directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Lift your right arm and left leg simultaneously, extending them straight out while maintaining balance. Then lower back to the plank position and pause for a few seconds.
Lift your left arm and right leg simultaneously, extending them straight out and return to the plank position and pause for a few seconds.
Continue alternating sides, lifting opposite arms and legs with a brief pause in the plank position.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and prevent your hips from sagging.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and maintain balance.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your arm and leg and inhaling as you pause in the plank position.
results.description: Alternate Arm Leg Plank Rest Pause is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Back, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Alternate Leg Pull
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended straight just off the floor and your arms extended overhead in line with your torso.
Lift your shoulders off the mat, engaging your core, and simultaneously bring your right knee towards your chest while swinging both arms in a circular motion until parallel to the floor.
Lower your right leg, arms and shoulders back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your left leg, bringing it towards your chest between your straight arms. Continue alternating sides in this manner.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maximize muscle activation and protect your lower back.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to avoid using momentum and ensure proper form.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you crunch and bring your leg towards your chest and inhaling as you lower back down.
results.description: Alternate Leg Pull is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Obliques.

results.name: Alternate Leg Raise From Reverse Plank Position
instructions: Lie down on your hips with your arms resting on the floor by your side and your legs extended forward.
Raise your upper back, bring your elbows under the shoulders, and bear weight on your forearms with your palms down.
Alternately raise and lower your legs to your maximum range while keeping them straight.
tips: Focus on maintaining a straight line with your body, avoiding any sagging or arching of the back.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your leg and inhaling as you lower it back down.
results.description: Alternate Leg Raise From Reverse Plank Position is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Hamstrings.

results.name: Alternate Leg Raise With Head Up
instructions: Lie down on your back with your arms resting on the floor by your side.
Raise your head and upper back off the floor, and lift your legs straight in the air, making a 90-degree angle with your torso.
Lower one of your legs and bring it back just before touching the floor.
Do the same with your other leg, and repeat.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and protect your lower back.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Maintain a steady breathing pattern, exhaling as you lift your leg and inhaling as you lower it back down.
results.description: Alternate Leg Raise With Head Up is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back.

Raise your head and upper back off the floor, and lift your legs straight in the air, making a 90-degree angle with your torso.
Lower one of your legs and bring it back just before touching the floor.
Do the same with your other leg, and repeat.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and protect your lower back.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.

results.description: Alternate Leg Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back.

results.name: Alternate Lying Floor Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended straight and your arms resting by your sides.
Lift both legs, straight towards the ceiling until they go past your hips.
Lower your legs halfway down, then lift them back up towards the ceiling.
Lower your legs back down to the initial position. Repeat the movement.
tips: Focus on keeping your upper back pressed into the mat to avoid arching and straining your spine.
Use your breath to guide the movement: inhale as you lift your legs and exhale as you lower them.
Engage your thigh muscles to assist with the lift and ensure proper form.
results.description: Alternate Lying Floor Leg Raise is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back.

results.name: Alternate Oblique Crunch
instructions: Lie down on your back and fold your knees while keeping your feet on the floor.
Place your right hand behind your head.
Raise and twist your chest to your left and bring your right elbow towards the left knee.
Return to the starting position and repeat.
tips: Focus on using your oblique muscles to twist your torso rather than pulling on your neck with your hands.
Keep your movements slow and controlled to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Ensure your lower back remains pressed into the mat to protect your spine.
results.description: Alternate Oblique Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Alternate Toe Tap Leg Lift
instructions: Lie down on your back with your knees bent and feet on the floor.
Raise your torso off the floor by placing your elbows on the floor and raise one of your knees toward the chest while keeping your knee bent.
Lower your foot back to the floor while raising your other knee towards your chest.
Keep repeating by alternately moving your knees towards and away from the chest.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and protect your lower back.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Focus on maintaining the bend in your knees and tapping the floor lightly to ensure proper form.
results.description: Alternate Toe Tap Leg Lift is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back.
